# Édouard Butaye

> Research scientist and CFD solver developer, currently a postdoctoral
> researcher at CEA Saclay. I work on the numerical simulation of turbulent and
> multiphase flows, across the whole chain: the physical analysis of a flow, the
> model that describes it, its implementation in production CFD software, and its
> validation against experiment.

I am looking for a postdoctoral position abroad, or a permanent research
scientist / CFD developer role, from February 2027. The best way to reach me is
ebutaye@sfr.fr.

Everything in this file is stated in plain sight on the pages it points to; it
exists to save a reader the trouble of reconstructing it from five pages.

## What I work on

- **Hybrid RANS-LES turbulence modelling** — implementation of the HTLES method
  in TrioCFD at CEA Saclay, and a physical criterion for locating the regions of
  a domain that genuinely require an LES description.
- **Particle-resolved simulation of fluid-particle flows** — the subject of my
  PhD (2024, laboratoire PROMES, Université de Perpignan Via Domitia), applied to
  anisothermal flows for concentrated solar power.
- **Multiscale simulation of two-phase boiling flows.**
- **Anisotropic mesh adaptation** — remeshing of inhomogeneous tetrahedral grids
  driven by a prescribed size map (MMG).
- **High-performance computing** — production runs on several thousand cores,
  GPU porting with Kokkos, C++ inside industrial solvers.
